answer: Trust is federated into islands, and weight crosses an island boundary only when an identity on one island has been endorsed by an identity on another that has no shared path back, so a farm confined to one island cannot export its internal reputation outward. This cost is per identity, so it cannot be amortised across the fleet. The cipher is the island, the ripple the endorsement that crosses it, and the signal the shared ancestor that would disqualify the crossing; one cipher is cheap to hold, but a ripple only counts when no signal exists, and that takes independent history.
